anatomy.name: Root
anatomy.action: Runs the consumer's onClick. Submits a form only when type="submit" is passed: type defaults to "button".

anatomy.name: Icon
anatomy.notes: Color inherits the Root's color (currentColor). In icon-only mode (shape set) it is the only visible content.

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.notes: Children wrapped in a plain span that carries the part marker; not wrapped in Text, since the Root sets the type styles. Rendered only when children are present. In icon-only mode the accessible name comes from aria-label instead.

anatomy.name: TrailingIcon
anatomy.when: trailingIcon is set and shape is unset

figma.note: Values recased (Square, Round). Icon-only buttons are a separate Figma set.
ADR-026 recorded mapping: optional prop omitted ↔ Has <x> (default false), plus the Icon instance swap.
ADR-026 recorded mapping: optional prop omitted ↔ Has <x> (default false), plus the Trailing icon instance swap (default chevron-down). Layer: TrailingIcon.
ADR-026 recorded mapping: label children ↔ Text.
In both sets (57:1265, 54:1192), built only at State=Default (ADR-025 amendment 2026-10-11).

constraints.reason: With shape set, the glyph is the only visible content and nothing renders a label, so the button needs an icon to show and an aria-label to have an accessible name.

states.name: active
states.notes: Momentary press, declared after hover so it wins while held. Distinct from aria-pressed, which is a persistent toggle (ADR-025 amendment).

states.name: focus-visible
states.notes: No component rule: the global ring in styles/reset.css applies (ADR-028), color.border.focus at size.focus.width, offset size.focus.offset.

states.name: disabled
states.notes: Native disabled, not aria-disabled: removes the button from the tab order and blocks activation.

ariaAttributes: aria-label (set on icon-only buttons via shape to provide an accessible name; flows through ...rest)
disabled (native HTML attribute via disabled prop, not aria-disabled)

keyboardInteractions.action: Moves focus to the next focusable element

accessibility.notes: Uses a native <button> element. The disabled prop sets the HTML disabled attribute, which natively prevents click events and removes the element from the tab order.

border-width.reason: No border-width token scale exists; every module uses a literal width.

border-color.reason: Keeps the 1px border on fill variants so every variant has the same height.

padding-inline.reason: The glyph is centred in a square box.

background.reason: Bordered look: no fill at rest.
Ghost button: no fill or border at rest (ADR-024).

divergences.what: The Button icon set has no Danger style.
divergences.decision: Accepted 2026-10-02: no icon-only danger button is used anywhere.

decisions.decision: Variants name an absolute visual weight (accent, neutral, transparent, danger), not a rank. The container decides which weight an action gets.
decisions.reason: Rank belongs to the group of buttons, not one button: a card's lead action is secondary on a page that already has a primary, and twelve cards would otherwise render twelve primaries.

decisions.decision: The default variant is neutral, not accent.
decisions.reason: A forgotten variant prop should not add a competing call to action.

decisions.decision: transparent is a ghost button: interactive text color, the size's standard padding and a hover fill. Its label sits inset from the content edge, with no bleed.
decisions.reason: A hover fill needs padding; the inset is accepted, as in Material 3 text buttons.

decisions.decision: Icon-only is a shape (square or round), not a variant. With shape set, icon and aria-label are required and children and trailingIcon are not allowed, enforced by the props type.
decisions.reason: The glyph is the only visible content, so the button needs an icon to show and an aria-label for its accessible name.

decisions.decision: type defaults to button, not submit.
decisions.reason: A button inside a form only submits it when the consumer asks for that.

decisions.decision: The label is not wrapped in Text.
decisions.reason: Root sets the type styles for every size.

ruledOut.reason: Rank changes with the container, so the name hides that dependency and needs a prose rule (one primary per view) to compensate.

ruledOut.option: An elevated variant (opaque surface) for buttons over images
ruledOut.reason: One consumer (CardVertical), it describes the background rather than emphasis, and the name collides with Material 3's Elevated level. CardVertical owns the over-media treatment instead.
Deferred: the right shape once a second consumer needs buttons over media; premature for one.

ruledOut.option: A transparent button with only a hover tint over images
ruledOut.reason: Hover doesn't fix resting contrast: WCAG 1.4.11 is judged at rest and touch has no hover.

ruledOut.option: A separate link variant styled like a text link
ruledOut.reason: Deferred: only justified by flush alignment. Add it when a real layout shows the transparent inset looks wrong.
ruledOut.source: Polaris plain, Primer link, Chakra v2 link

ruledOut.option: A negative-margin bleed prop to align the label with the content edge
ruledOut.reason: Deferred for the same reason as a link variant. If ever needed it lives on Button, never in layout files.
